projectDescription: An AI-powered Salesforce development platform that automates code generation, impact analysis, and multi-agent orchestration for Salesforce teams.
keyFeatures: AI Agent Team (AXIOM, FORGE, SYNTH, GUARDIAN, SENTINEL) for autonomous Salesforce development
POD Execution — isolated E2B sandbox environments that push results to Git branches
Salesforce Metadata Intelligence with governor limit analysis and dependency graphs
Action Plan Orchestration — visual multi-agent workflow planning and execution
Impact Analysis Pro — three-mode analysis (Quick, Smart, Comprehensive) before deployments
Workflow Builder — node-based visual canvas for automation design
MCP Server — Model Context Protocol integration for Claude Desktop and Cursor IDE
LLM Provider Configuration — bring-your-own API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, and others
GitHub CI/CD Integration — automated analysis triggered on pull requests
Discovery Tracks — guided requirements gathering for Salesforce implementations
publicApiSurface: POST /api/v2/board/pod-execute — launch POD execution for task IDs
POST /api/v2/projects/create-with-connections — create project with Salesforce/GitHub links
POST /api/ai/generate — generate Salesforce component from prompt
POST /api/threads/:id/messages — send a message to an agent thread
